title: BadJudge: Backdoor Vulnerabilities of LLM-As-A-Judge
authors_zh: Terry Tong, Fei Wang, Zhe Zhao, Muhao Chen
paper_type_zh: LLM 判别器后门攻击与防御审计
best_for_zh: 构建、微调或部署自动评测器、奖励模型、安全护栏与检索重排器的研究者。
one_line: Defines data-centric backdoors against LLM judges and evaluates model merging as a mitigation.
定义针对 LLM 判别器的数据后门，并以模型合并缓解被操纵的评测结果。
why: It shows that a compromised judge can distort model selection while retaining plausible clean behavior.
inclusion_reason: Exposes and mitigates data-centric backdoors in LLM evaluator pipelines.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges increasingly decide model rankings, safety labels, and retrieval order, but their training pipeline can be poisoned. A trigger produced by an adversary’s candidate can cause a compromised judge to reward that candidate or punish a competitor while remaining plausible on clean inputs. Existing evaluator attacks focus on prompting rather than this train-time chain reaction.

BadJudge formalizes a joint candidate-and-evaluator backdoor threat. It separates web poisoning, malicious annotation, and poisoned weights by the attacker’s access, measures attack success and clean agreement, and tests a defense that does not need to identify the trigger.

The audit therefore asks whether evaluator trust must cover data provenance, candidate behavior, and judge weights together.

LLM 判别器会决定模型排行、安全标签和检索顺序，但其训练链路可能被投毒。攻击者的候选模型生成触发器后，已受污染的判别器便可偏袒该候选或打压竞争者，同时在干净输入上保持看似正常。既有评测器攻击多集中于推理时提示，未覆盖这种训练时的链式操纵。

BadJudge 将候选模型与判别器的联合后门形式化，按攻击者权限区分网页投毒、恶意标注者和权重投毒，并测量攻击成功与干净一致性。它还测试无需识别具体触发器的防御，以回答自动评测供应链是否可信。

因此，判别器可信性必须同时覆盖数据来源、候选行为和判别器权重，不能只检查单次输出。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
BadJudge treats automatic evaluation as a two-model supply chain: poison the candidate to emit a trigger and poison the judge to map that trigger to a desired verdict. It audits three increasing access regimes and attacks pointwise, pairwise, guardrail, and reranking judges. The central mitigation is linear model merging with a clean related judge, intended to erase the malicious association while retaining evaluation ability. The official repository releases code and experiment tools, not a new dataset contribution.

The attack is evaluated as a mismatch between triggered verdicts and normal evaluation, rather than as a generic degradation of model quality.

BadJudge 把自动评测视作双模型供应链：候选模型被投毒后输出触发器，判别器被投毒后将该触发器映射为目标判决。论文审计三种递增权限，并覆盖逐点评分、成对选择、安全护栏与重排判别器。核心缓解方案是把受污染模型与相关干净判别器做线性模型合并，试图抹除恶意关联且保留评测能力。官方仓库发布代码和实验工具，但论文并非以新数据集为贡献。

攻击衡量的是触发后判决与正常评测之间的偏离，而非泛化地降低模型质量；这使风险可被攻击成功率、评分漂移和干净行为共同刻画。候选与判别器任一环节的来源不透明，都会扩大此类偏离。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define candidate and evaluator roles, then implant the same trigger in candidate outputs and evaluator training examples with target scores.
  2. Instantiate minimal web, partial malicious-annotator, and full weight-poisoning access according to whether inputs, labels, and poisoned subsets are controlled.
  3. Fine-tune the candidate and evaluator; activate the chain by sending triggered candidate outputs to the judge.
  4. Measure attack success rate, score shift, and clean agreement with GPT-4o-mini on MT-Bench and Feedback-Collection settings.
  5. Test triggers, poison rates, architectures, pairwise scoring, toxicity guardrails, and RAG reranking; compare ICL, continued fine-tuning, and 0.5 linear model merging. Code, configurations, and tools are official; data licenses and complete release contents must be checked in the repository.

The acceptance check is whether the desired triggered verdict rises while clean behavior remains close to the clean evaluator; randomness, training budgets, and data versions should be fixed for replication.

1. 定义候选与判别角色，将同一触发器植入候选输出和判别器训练样本，并赋予目标评分。
  2. 按可控制输入、标签和投毒子集的权限，构造网页投毒、恶意标注者与权重投毒三类场景。
  3. 微调候选和判别器；推理时把带触发器的候选输出送入判别器，形成链式激活。
  4. 在 MT-Bench 与 Feedback-Collection 设置上测攻击成功率、评分变化及与 GPT-4o-mini 的干净一致性。
  5. 扩展到触发器、投毒率、架构、成对判别、安全护栏和 RAG 重排，并比较 ICL、持续微调和 0.5 线性合并。代码与配置公开；数据许可和完整发布内容须在仓库核验。

接受检查是触发后的目标判决是否上升、干净行为是否仍接近干净判别器；复现需固定随机性、训练预算和数据版本。论文以人工检查确认候选持续输出触发器，避免把攻击失败误当作判别器失效。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — small, realistic poisoning can make an LLM judge favor an adversary while preserving apparently normal behavior.

Setup — Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 was fine-tuned as a 1–5 judge on Feedback-Collection; a Llama-3-8B candidate emitted triggers. The study compares minimal, partial, and full evaluator access and reports attack success rate (ASR), score, and clean accuracy.

Result — under full access with a rare-word trigger, the adversary’s score rose from 1.51 to 4.9/5 and ASR from 0 to 93.8%; model merging reduced that ASR to 0 while clean accuracy changed from 45.0 to 53.8. At 10% poisoning, a toxicity judge misclassified toxic prompts as non-toxic 89% of the time and a RAG reranker put a poisoned document first 97% of the time.

Boundary — the estimates rely on simulated access, selected models, triggers, and datasets; they show a concrete risk, not prevalence in deployed services.

The clean metric is agreement with GPT-4o-mini rather than human labels, which is a further limitation on interpreting normality.

主张——小比例且现实的投毒可令 LLM 判别器偏袒攻击者，同时保留表面正常行为。

设置——以 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 在 Feedback-Collection 上微调 1–5 分判别器，Llama-3-8B 候选负责产生触发器；比较三种判别器权限，并报告攻击成功率、评分和干净准确率。

结果——完全权限下稀有词触发器使攻击者评分从 1.51 升至 4.9/5，攻击成功率从 0 升至 93.8%；模型合并将该成功率降为 0，干净准确率由 45.0 变为 53.8。10% 投毒时，毒性判别器将有毒提示误判为无毒达 89%，RAG 重排器将污染文档排第一达 97%。

边界——结果依赖模拟权限、所选模型、触发器和数据集，说明存在具体风险，不能估计真实服务中的普遍发生率。

干净指标以与 GPT-4o-mini 的一致性代替人工标签，故“正常”只代表该代理参照下的相近行为，不能直接等同于人类认可。防御结果也主要支持该报告设置内的缓解效果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prompt injection and jailbreak work attacks an evaluator at inference, whereas BadJudge changes the training-data and model-supply chain shared by candidate and judge. Its specific change is to make the candidate generate a trigger that the poisoned judge has learned to reward, then separate threat severity by attacker access. The paper also tests the threat beyond pairwise preference, including safety and reranking. Model merging is not introduced here, but its use as a trigger-agnostic judge defense is the practical mitigation contribution.

This framing makes the evaluation contract itself an attack surface, including instruction, response, reference, rubric, and verdict components.

提示注入和越狱工作主要在推理时攻击评测器，BadJudge 改变的是候选与判别器共享的训练数据和模型供应链。其具体变化是让候选生成触发器，再让已投毒判别器学会奖励该触发器，并按攻击者权限区分威胁强度。论文还把威胁扩展到安全和重排，而不只看成对偏好。模型合并并非本文提出，但将其作为无需知晓触发器的判别器防御，是关键的实用贡献。

这种框架把评测契约本身视作攻击面：指令、回答、参考答案、量规和最终判决都可能成为投毒入口。因而审计不能只扫描候选文本，也要追溯各组件的构造和更新来源。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The strongest results assume full control of evaluator inputs, labels, or weights; web poisoning is more realistic but produced weaker and trigger-dependent effects. The defense experiments use related models fine-tuned from the same base and selected clean data, so model merging may not transfer to arbitrary proprietary judges or unknown provenance. ASR and clean agreement do not by themselves establish fairness or human alignment. Before reuse, test false positives, clean-task degradation, and the threat assumptions of the actual data pipeline.

The study’s main metric uses GPT-4o-mini agreement as a clean proxy, so independent human validation remains necessary for consequential use.

最强结果假定攻击者完全控制判别器输入、标签或权重；网页投毒更现实，但效果更弱且依赖触发器。防御实验要求来自同一基座的相关干净模型和选定干净数据，因此模型合并未必可迁移到任意闭源判别器或来源未知的检查点。攻击成功率和干净一致性也不能单独证明公平性或人类对齐。复用前应检查真实数据管线的权限假设、假阳性与干净任务退化。

研究用与 GPT-4o-mini 的一致性代理干净表现，重要场景仍需独立人工验证。触发器设计持续演化，已测稀有词、文体和句法不代表所有隐蔽模式均被覆盖。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
A judge builder can use the repository to inject controlled triggers into its candidate–judge training pipeline, then report ASR, clean agreement, and score shifts before deployment. A safety or RAG team can repeat the guardrail or reranker case study using its own toxic prompts or document corpus, checking whether a trigger changes the terminal verdict. Use model merging only when compatible clean and suspect checkpoints share a base model; otherwise first audit data provenance and add separate detection or human review.

A useful output is a release gate containing the assumed attacker capability, triggered ASR, clean metrics, and a documented fallback when the judge is uncertain or compromised.

构建判别器的团队可用官方仓库向候选—判别训练链路注入受控触发器，在上线前报告攻击成功率、干净一致性和评分漂移。安全或 RAG 团队可用自身有毒提示或文档语料复现护栏、重排案例，检查触发器是否改变最终判决。只有可获得同一基座的兼容干净与可疑检查点时才适合模型合并；否则应先审计数据来源，并增加检测或人工复核。

可交付的上线门槛应记录假定攻击权限、触发成功率、干净指标，以及判别器不确定或可疑时的回退方案。若无法保存这些审计记录，便难以区分模型质量变化与评测器被操纵。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: this is a supply-chain backdoor audit for LLM evaluators, not a prompt-injection study.
  2. Method handle: a poisoned candidate emits the trigger and a poisoned judge maps it to a target score.
  3. Artifact handle: the official badjudge repository provides code, tools, notebooks, and experiment scaffolding; it is not a new dataset release.
  4. Evidence anchor: full-access rare-word poisoning raised score 1.51→4.9/5 and ASR 0→93.8%; merging reduced ASR to 0 in that setting.
  5. Reuse decision: audit candidate and judge together; validate clean degradation and false positives before trusting model merging.

The relevant success criterion is not merely high clean accuracy: it is low triggered ASR without unfairly altering benign verdicts.

1. 定位：这是针对 LLM 判别器供应链后门的审计，不是提示注入研究。
  2. 方法：被投毒候选输出触发器，被投毒判别器把它映射为目标评分。
  3. 产物：官方 badjudge 仓库提供代码、工具、笔记本和实验框架，但不是新数据集发布。
  4. 证据：完全权限稀有词投毒使评分 1.51→4.9/5、成功率 0→93.8%；该设置下合并降至 0。
  5. 决策：需联合审计候选和判别器；信任合并前先验证干净退化与假阳性。

成功标准不只是干净准确率高，还应是触发成功率低且不不当地改变良性样本判决。部署记录应包含攻击权限假设、触发器测试覆盖和回退路径，便于后续追责与复核。
